figures.title: One workload portfolio, four operating outcomes
figures.desc: A workload portfolio branches into a qualified endpoint route, a bounded degrade mode, a routing hold when no eligible mode remains, and an authorized manual procedure.
figures.caption: Portfolio topology begins with workload slices; each branch needs its own gates, evidence, owner, and trigger.
figures.transcript: The source is a portfolio of workload slices, each defined by an acceptance bar, hard constraints, priorities, and a degradation envelope. A route branch goes to a qualified primary endpoint and any separately qualified conditional alternate. A bounded degrade mode is separately evidenced and preserves every non-degradable invariant. A hold-routing branch stops the workload only when no eligible route, degrade, or manual mode remains. A manual branch goes to a named human procedure with authority, capacity, timing, and an inspectable record. These portfolio dispositions are different from P8 benchmark hold and degrade labels.

figures.title: Route by gates before tradeoffs
figures.desc: A five-stage routing mechanism freezes workload requirements, attaches endpoint evidence, applies hard gates, compares only eligible candidates by declared preferences, and records the route plus contingencies.
figures.caption: Keep requirements and evidence separate; preferences begin only after every hard gate passes for that candidate-and-mode.
figures.transcript: First freeze one workload slice with acceptance, data, authority, deadline, evidence, resilience, cost, and degradation requirements. Second attach workload-specific endpoint evidence with conditions, date, sample, dependency tags, and uncertainty. Third make each candidate-and-mode with a failed or material unknown gate ineligible; hold the workload only if no qualified mode remains. Fourth compare only eligible candidates using the workload's declared priority or tradeoff; do not use a universal score. Fifth record the primary route, separately qualified alternate, bounded degrade or manual mode, exclusions, owner, and revisit trigger.

figures.title: Let the condition choose the operating outcome
figures.desc: A decision surface maps five portfolio conditions to route, bounded degrade mode, hold routing, manual, or stop-and-return actions.
figures.caption: Read the signal before choosing continuity; stopping or holding is correct when invariants or authority cannot be preserved.
figures.transcript: When every hard gate passes and a candidate wins the declared comparison, route the workload and record its conditions. When a separately evidenced reduced mode preserves all invariants inside its declared bounds, mark bounded degrade mode and record what was lost. A failed or material unknown gate makes that candidate-mode ineligible; mark hold routing only when no qualified route, degrade, or manual mode remains. When policy reserves authority and a named human procedure has capacity, timing, and a record, use manual. When available modes conflict with a legal, safety, data, or authority invariant, stop and return to the accountable authority.
